items.title: Blixo for Xero Users: How Finance Teams Cut Manual Invoicing in 30 Days
items.summary: Blixo for Xero Users: How Finance Teams Cut Manual Subscription Billing Key Takeaways Manual invoice processing costs over $3 per invoice once you include errors. 66% of businesses spend more than five days monthly on invoice work. Finance teams with 100 subscriptions spend half their time on billing tasks. Subscription businesses often need dedicated staff at around 500 subscriptions. SaaS companies need billing that scales without adding headcount. Why Manual Invoice Processing in Xero Breaks Down Finance teams hit the same wall: manual invoice processing eats time. For SaaS subscription companies, recurring billing must scale without new hires. Manual workflows stop working once you pass a few dozen subscriptions.

items.title: Pagero for Invoice Management: How Its E-Invoicing Network Compares With Billtrust and Corcentric
items.summary: Key Takeaways Pagero handles e-invoicing compliance across 70 countries and serves 86,000 customers, with a 2% churn rate and 84% CSAT. Teams running AR automation report cost savings of up to 80%. One global food and agri conglomerate cut invoice cycle time by over 70% and hit 99% error-free transactions. Mandates are active or close in Belgium, Poland, France, and India, so e-invoicing is a legal requirement in those markets, not a preference. Penalties run from Rs 10,000 to Rs 25,000 in India and up to €15,000 per year across several EU countries. Pagero’s marquee deployments run full AR automation in far fewer countries than it validates. Hewlett Packard Enterprise covers 29 of the 70 supported. E-invoicing networks kill manual re-keying by passing validated, structured documents straight from sender to recipient. Why E-Invoicing Went From Optional to Mandatory In much of the world, e-invoicing stopped being optional. It is law now, and the numbers explain why buyers care. Evaluate an AP/AR automation vendor like Pagero on invoice management, and you are looking at compliance coverage across 70 countries with real-time schema validation, 86,000 customers, a 2% churn rate, and 84% CSAT. Those figures show the model works at scale.
